label: Copy phase, fed-back input is one of 3/t/j/v/u/c/e (from 2nd copied token on)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or on <DEL>), and essentially never at the first copy input (recall_idx 1, rate 2%) or when to_go >= 7. Strongly token-selective on the fed-back input: 3, t, j, v, u, c, e (rates 12-24%, about 84% of mass), weaker for 2, o, 1, and rare for most other letters. Rate and mass peak at recall_idx 2-4 (t = 10-12); the strongest activations are t/j/v/3 at the 2nd-3rd copy step, often in a run of these tokens (e.g. u j v c ... -> j, v both at max). Does not fire on in_first steps (first occurrences), which follows from being copy-only. Precision is limited (~46%): many matching-token copy steps stay below threshold, and the dependence on position and neighbouring tokens is graded rather than captured by a clean rule.
